quests.instruction: SEQUENCE THE DISPATCH SEGMENTS CHRONOLOGICALLY INTO THEIR SLOTS
quests.prompt: [Calibration Dispatch 111-1] Draft an official mission brief describing the discovery of thermal chimney fields in the Mariana Trench.
options: WE HAVE SUCCESSFULLY DOCUMENTED ACTIVE HYDROTHERMAL CHIMNEYS VENTING SUPERHEATED CHEMICAL PLUMES.
quests.hint: Place the SUBJ: line as the Subject, 'DEAR' as Salutation, 'WE HAVE' as Body, and 'REGARDS' as Sign-Off. (Diving calibration index 111-1)
quests.explanation: A standard scientific dispatch follows a subject header, formal greeting, central briefing statement, and professional signature. [Verified by Academy Dispatch Unit 111].

quests.prompt: [Calibration Dispatch 111-2] Draft a research status dispatch reporting on chemosynthetic bacteria colonies around abyssal geothermal springs.
options: BACTERIAL CULTURES DEMONSTRATE SUSTAINED METABOLIC CONVERSION OF HYDROGEN SULFIDE WITHOUT SOLAR BEAMS.
quests.hint: Map the UPDATE subject to Subject, formal salutation, sulfur metabolic body, and SINCERELY signature. (Diving calibration index 111-2)
quests.explanation: Correspondence structures dictate separating administrative titles, salutations, core evidence paragraphs, and sign-offs. [Verified by Academy Dispatch Unit 111].
